key_path: Sign up at twilio.com/try-twilio (no card needed for trial)
Console home shows Account SID + Auth Token (usable immediately)
Optional: `twilio login` (CLI prompts for SID + Auth Token, mints a Standard API key into a local profile) or Console > API keys
human_gates: manual_approval (A2P 10DLC brand/campaign registration for US SMS beyond trial; DLT entity/template registration for India SMS)
credit_card_required (to upgrade off trial; trial only sends to <=5 verified recipient numbers in sign-up country)

agent_native_auth.cli_browser_or_device_login: no - `twilio login` takes pasted Account SID + Auth Token, then auto-creates a Standard API key stored as a profile
agent_native_auth.oauth_dcr_for_mcp: no for product MCP (docs MCP is unauthenticated); 'execute-ready, OAuth-authenticated MCP tools' listed as planned
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mints_keys: yes - Keys API (v1/2010) creates Standard and Restricted keys; subaccounts API; Main keys console-only
agent_native_auth.scoped_keys: yes - Restricted API keys with fine-grained permissions
agent_native_auth.test_credentials_sandbox: yes - test credentials + magic numbers; mock A2P 10DLC brands/campaigns API; WhatsApp sandbox
agent_native_auth.free_tier: trial only: 30 days, product-specific free units (100 SMS, 3,000 emails, 75 voice min)

mcp.docs_mcp: remote https://mcp.twilio.com/docs, Streamable HTTP, no auth; 2 tools (twilio__search, twilio__retrieve) over 1,800+ endpoints incl. SendGrid + Segment docs; Public Beta; read-only
mcp.product_mcp_local: @twilio-alpha/mcp (npx, v0.7.0, Account SID + API key/secret args) - Twilio Labs alpha, exposes all Twilio APIs via OpenAPI
mcp.one_click: Claude Connector directory listing; Cursor marketplace plugin `/add-plugin twilio-developer-kit`; `claude mcp add --transport http twilio-docs https://mcp.twilio.com/docs`; Twilio Skills

docs_for_agents.markdown_pages: yes - every docs page available at .md with JSON-LD front matter and dateModified
docs_for_agents.agents_md_or_rules: Twilio Skills (procedural packages) via Cursor plugin; no AGENTS.md seen

time_to_first_call_notes: ~10 min to first trial SMS to the sign-up phone (human clears email + phone OTP and pastes SID/token). Production US SMS to arbitrary numbers: days-weeks (10DLC review); India: DLT registration.
agent_friendliness_justification: Excellent agent docs (.md everywhere, unauthenticated docs MCP, Claude/Cursor listings) but credentials are still copy-paste SID/token, product MCP is alpha/local only, and messaging is wrapped in phone OTP + carrier regulation.
best_practice: Unauthenticated, hosted search-then-retrieve docs MCP over the full OpenAPI surface (two tools, context-efficient) - zero setup before an account exists.
biggest_gap: No OAuth/device login and no hosted product MCP: an agent cannot act on the account without a human pasting the Auth Token; regulatory gates (10DLC/DLT) are unavoidable human work.
